summary: This joint resolution nullifies the final rule issued by the Financial Crimes Enforcement Network (FinCEN) titled Anti-Money Laundering/Countering the Financing of Terrorism Program and Suspicious Activity Report Filing Requirements for Registered Investment Advisers and Exempt Reporting Advisers and published on September 4, 2024. The rule expands existing anti-money laundering and counterterror financing requirements (e.g., reporting suspicious financial activity to FinCEN) to include certain investment advisers.
